subject: MSA redlines & onboarding checkpoint — need to shift calendar
messages:
-----Original Message-----
From: Samantha Reilly <samantha.reilly@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acme.com>, legal@acme.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redlines & onboarding checkpoint

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the SOW. Legal has reviewed the latest MSA and included a set of redlines — see attached PDF (Acme_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf). We want to get the redline call on the calendar this week so we can close procurement and start provisioning (targeting Oct 1).

Proposed agenda (60 min):
- 30 min: walk through legal redlines & clarifying Qs (Acme legal + Redwood legal)
- 15 min: procurement terms (PO / billing cadence)
- 15 min: vendor onboarding checklist & next steps (technical ops + account team)

Available windows (Pacific):
- Fri 9/11 10:00–11:00am
- Mon 9/14 9:00–10:00am or 2:00–3:00pm

If those don't work, please propose 2 alternate windows. Also please confirm who from Redwood should join (we expect legal + 1 AM + 1 ops).

Thanks,
Samantha Reilly
Head of Procurement — Acme Manufacturing
Samantha.reilly@acme.com
Acme Corp | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: Acme_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)

-----Reply-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reilly <samantha.reilly@acme.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines & onboarding checkpoint

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending this over and for the clear agenda. We can absolutely prioritize this. I'm attaching our internal onboarding checklist (vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) to help frame the ops section.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Redwood attendees: myself (AM / exec sponsor), Aditya Rao (legal liaison), Laura Bennett (technical onboarding lead). Jonas Weber will join for procurement-level questions if needed.
- The 9/11 10:00 slot works for Aditya but I have a product roadmap review at that time. 9/14 9:00–10:00am looks clean for all of us.

Proposed: book Mon 9/14 09:00–10:00 PT; we'll split the agenda exactly as you outlined and we can shorten to 45 minutes if you'd prefer a focused redline-only discussion followed by an ops-only follow-up.

Agenda note: could you flag any redlines that are especially time-sensitive (e.g., indemnity/data residency/termination language)? That will help us prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0222

Looping in: short thought — we should suggest a two-part cadence to reduce meeting fatigue: 30 min legal-only to settle high-risk redlines, then a 30 min ops call with Laura to run the checklist and provisioning timeline. If Acme agrees, we can send two linked calendar invites back-to-back.

Also: I'll pre-digest the redlines and flag the three clauses I think will require escalation (indemnity cap, data processing terms, audit access). Will share notes before the call.
